name: Beeline: the press that opens the map (still held when it appears) never starts a trip

steps.mark: precondition: nothing targeted, not right next to an NPC or the aetheryte (Cross may also reach the game)
hold Cross, open the map while it is held (like Map from the journal), release it

steps.waitFor: event:\[Beeline\] The button that opened the map is still held
steps.msg: Beeline should notice the button already held
releasing that press must not start a trip
